cut: v1 render (27 Oct): Toko set 2/4, the shared studio (clay/studio/set.js); the owner's still notes taken — shot 3 full face with less bloom, shot 4's box bigger and set by the crate, drones flying in front of the park card · v2 (28 Oct): the owner's slogan on the card; boxes out from behind the lid's edge; the keeper is reached before it lifts
argument: With AI, working prototypes are cheap and fast, but none is fun until someone shapes one; knowing what to make is the scarce part now.
syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word; in Japanese a space marks a reveal segment and is never drawn

captions.source: Observed, not reported: the film shows one way of working, Toko's own. No product or tool is named; the boxes are drawn for the film.

post.en: Ten prototypes in a week. All of them work. None is fun, until someone shapes one. Making is cheap now. Knowing what to make isn't. #gamedev #indiedev #AI #claymation
post.fi: Kymmenen prototyyppiä viikossa. Kaikki toimivat. Yksikään ei ole hauska, ennen kuin joku muotoilee yhden. Tekeminen on halpaa. Tietää, mitä tehdä, ei ole. #pelinkehitys #indiedev #tekoäly
post.ja: 1週間で試作10本。全部動く。でも楽しくない。誰かが形にするまでは。作るのは安い。何を作るかは安くない。#ゲーム開発 #インディーゲーム #AI
